items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: I remember Dickie Thompson, a guitarist, and so on.

ctx.x: Stride piano player. I mean when I look at pictures in the book I say, yeah, I know this guy. I remember Dickie Thompson, a guitarist, and so on.
What was your first jazz record that you listened when you were young?
